introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to Homework Supply. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our Japanese language learning platform.

informationWeCollect.heading: 2. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, information we collect automatically, and information from third-party sources.

howWeUseInfo.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInfo.content: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our services, communicate with you, and ensure platform security.
howWeUseInfo.provideServices: Provide and maintain our learning platform
howWeUseInfo.analyzeTrends: Analyze usage trends and improve features

dataStorage.heading: 4. Data Storage and Security
dataStorage.content: We store your data securely using AWS services with encryption and access controls.
dataStorage.awsStorage: Data stored in AWS DynamoDB and S3
dataStorage.encryption: Encryption in transit and at rest

dataSharing.heading: 5. Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers and in legal situations.
dataSharing.serviceProviders: With service providers (AWS, OpenAI for AI features)
dataSharing.instructors: With your instructors for educational purposes
dataSharing.legalRequirements: When required by law or to protect rights

yourRights.heading: 6. Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have rights regarding your personal data including access, correction, and deletion.
yourRights.optOut: Opt out of certain data collection

cookies.heading: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience and analyze platform usage.

childrensPrivacy.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: Our platform may be used by students of various ages. Parental consent may be required for users under 13.

policyChanges.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
policyChanges.content: We may update this privacy policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes via email or platform notification.

contactUs.heading: 10. Contact Us
contactUs.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@homeworksupply.com.
